items.title: File Widerspruch against Pflegegrad decision
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei: Pflegekasse bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 20.11.2026; no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated, so the posting day equals the letter date (20.11.2026). The letter itself states delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting: 21.11 (day 1), 22.11 (day 2), 23.11 (day 3), 24.11.2026 (day 4, Tuesday) = deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe). The Pflegekasse is a social-law body (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X); the deemed-delivery day is not moved even if it fell on a weekend/holiday (it does not here anyway, as 24.11.2026 is a Tuesday). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG / SGB X Widerspruchsverfahren) starts the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later on the day with the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 24.11.2026 + 1 month = 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24 December is a working day (not a public holiday itself), so the deadline does not shift further under § 193 BGB.
